status: Issue 1 production-ready story package; Issues 2-6 development map only
issueFormat: Variable-length collected comic issues. Page count follows the mission rather than a fixed monthly target.

issues.title: Observed Twice
issues.spine: A red, unverified public corridor is needed by a waiting Verge relief convoy. Ghostwind Arrow discovers that apparently safe survey telemetry is partly a physical echo of an older route solution embedded in the corridor volume. The crew proves that the old path is no longer the live path, maps a narrow recurring transit window, keeps the public beacon red, and escorts the convoy through under direct scout control rather than falsely certifying the route.
issues.seriesFunction: Establish the crew, provisional-language culture, objective Lattice strangeness, civilian consequences, and the difference between 'transit possible' and 'route certified.'

issues.title: Dead Reckoning
issues.spine: A contact repeatedly appears just outside active sensor geometry along an uncertified route. The crew must determine whether they are being shadowed, observing a reflection/echo regime, or revealing their own position through the way they search.
issues.guardrail: Do not make the answer a supernatural pursuer or another version of Issue 1's stored telemetry.

issues.title: False Green
issues.spine: A remote route is reported safe by local infrastructure while field pilots insist it is moving. Ghostwind Arrow must separate infrastructure failure, data-chain contamination, local pilot experience, and actual corridor drift before traffic resumes.
issues.guardrail: Public beacons default red on unsafe or sensor failure. Any false-safe condition must have a concrete causal explanation rather than casually breaking beacon canon.

issues.title: The Quiet Volume
issues.spine: A rescue call leads into a region where ordinary ranging and return signals disappear instead of echoing. The absence of information becomes the physical problem, forcing the crew to navigate and search through constraints rather than spectacle.

issues.title: Return Vector
issues.spine: A survey probe returns intact from an uncertified crossing with its physical route log and inertial history in disagreement. The crew must determine which record reflects the path actually traveled before sending a person after it.

issues.title: The Edge of the Map
issues.spine: An independent survey route could reconnect an isolated settlement faster than the official corridor program, but its evidence is incomplete and commercially controlled. Ghostwind Arrow must verify enough of the route to make a rescue decision without pretending private claims are public certification.
